name: CycleWire
summary: The reference page activated by CycleWire: the 4.7 kB core loads up front, and each interaction's code loads when someone reaches for it. Nothing hydrates.

idioms.choice: The core loads as a module in <head>, with a modulepreload link, as the performance guide recommends.
Vite bundles the page's script, and fromGlob(import.meta.glob('./actions/*.js')) registers every action as its own chunk. Vite preloads a chunk's dependencies when it is imported.
The server writes the entry's <script> and <link rel="modulepreload"> tags from Vite's manifest.
Add to cart is preloaded when the browser is idle (data-cw-preload="idle"), since most visitors use it; everything else loads on intent, the default.
The cart header is bound to a store the server serializes (data-cw-store, data-cw-bind); cyclewire/signals arrives with the cart action.
The quick view fetches JSON and renders it with cyclewire/dom, which arrives with that action.
